label: DEVELOPMENT evidence: every row is dated before 2026-09-01; the approved bars were also chosen on rows before 2026-09-01, so the tip set is in-sample for its bar. A PROVEN here only opens a forward paper protocol from 2026-11-21; nothing changes production.
question: Do the clean model's O/U tips (approved cell bar) perform better when the sharp market moved the same way before the bet, and is that more than following the sharp move alone?

data.store: NevixAA/wowza-exec branch odds-history (PRIVATE), read only through src/oddsapi_history_adapter.py attach()
data.roles: B4 intermediate snapshots = MOVEMENT (signal inputs and bet prices); B4 last snapshot and B1 = CLOSE (CLV only, never a signal input or bet price); BT = BET (question 4 only: the live-tip lead time)
data.results: output/fd_history.parquet (full-time goals, exact join on date, league, home, away; a row contradicting the universe's own over25 outcome is excluded and counted) - used ONLY to settle the 1X2 market-only arm
data.no_1x2_model: The clean Phase-2 predictions carry no 1X2 market (over15/25/35, btts, ht_over05/15 only). The 1X2 model arm is NOT_TESTABLE; 1X2 enters only the market-only arm. Nothing is substituted.

tips.rule: A model tip = src.bars_opt.serve.score with the cell's own approved source, fitted source_params, measure, odds range and VALUABLE bar, evaluated at the BET price (below) and the power de-vig fair price of that same pair. Only MODEL-mode cells; LEAGUE_WIDE cells (bet every match, no model signal) are listed and not tested in the model arm. OFF cells have no bar and no tips.

prices.bet_price: Pinnacle's own two-sided pair on the market's exact line (1.5 / 2.5 / 3.5) for O/U, Pinnacle's own home/draw/away triple for 1X2, read from the BET SNAPSHOT of the window (role MOVEMENT). One book's real pre-kickoff price; never best-of-books, never a consensus, never a CLOSE snapshot. No pair in that snapshot -> no bet (no other snapshot or book stands in).
prices.clv: odds / closing odds - 1 with the closing price from Pinnacle's LATEST CLOSE-role snapshot of the same line: tier B1 (the match's own close, kickoff - 5 min) first, else B4's last snapshot; only when that close is later than the bet snapshot. 1X2: B4 CLOSE only.

W72_6.note: primary: T-72h -> T-6h, bet at the price in the snapshot the signal was read from (the bet is placed after that snapshot is seen; the signal uses only that snapshot and earlier)

W72_6_next.note: strict execution: the bet price is the first MOVEMENT snapshot STRICTLY after the signal snapshot

snapshot_choice: B4 featured snapshots are timed off the league-day's FIRST kickoff and an event can sit in two league-day units, so labels are not a match's lead time. Each fixture's snapshots are chosen by their ACTUAL lead (provider's latest kickoff - snapshot_ts): the MOVEMENT snapshot inside the window's lead range closest to the target (tie: the later). Measured before registration (no outcome read): 24,722 matched fixtures, median 9 distinct snapshots each; Pinnacle present in [60,84] h for 20,841, [4,10] h for 23,967, [18,30] h for 23,604; Pinnacle quotes exactly one totals line per snapshot.

signal.devig_ou: src.market_edge.power_devig of the book's own pair
signal.devig_1x2: proportional normalisation of the book's own home/draw/away triple
signal.PIN: O/U: change of Pinnacle's fair Over probability open -> signal on the line Pinnacle quotes at both snapshots (nearest 2.5 if several; kind SAME). If Pinnacle quotes at both snapshots but on different lines, its main line moved: direction = sign(line change) (up = toward Over), counted as beyond any threshold (kind LINE). 1X2: change of Pinnacle's fair probability of each side.
signal.CONS: the MEDIAN over the other books (every bookmaker except Pinnacle) quoting the exact 2.5 pair (1X2: the full triple) at BOTH snapshots of the per-book fair-probability change; requires at least consensus_min_books such books.
signal.BOTH: AGREE / DISAGREE / NONE only when PIN and CONS give the same class; otherwise MIXED (reported, not tested).
signal.threshold: per league x market (x side for 1X2) x signal x window: the `quantile` of |change| over the SAME league's fixtures dated STRICTLY earlier (prices only, never an outcome); WARMUP (no class, excluded and counted) while fewer than `min_history` earlier measured fixtures exist. Learned from earlier data only; no global number.
signal.classes: For a bet on side s: AGREE = the move toward s beyond the threshold; DISAGREE = against s beyond it; NONE = measured and within it; NO_DATA = not measurable (no pair at a snapshot, too few books, WARMUP).

arms.model: per window x signal x track x market-side x league x class (AGREE / DISAGREE / NONE) plus ALL (every tip of the cell at the window's bet price, signal-independent)
arms.market: market-only baseline, no model: per window x signal x league x side, bet the side the sharp signal moved TOWARD (class AGREE for that side) at the same Pinnacle bet price. O/U 2.5 Over / Under and 1X2 home / draw / away, every fixture of the clean universe in a B4 league (both tracks).

stats.roi_ci_and_p: src.bars_opt.study.score: block bootstrap by match date (2,000), CI = widest of block CI and max-of-three SE; one-sided p = (k+1)/(B+1), k = resampled means <= 0. A p at the 2,000-draw floor is re-drawn with ceil(10 * family / 0.025) resamples (study.fast_one_sided_p), as in the bars study.
stats.win_minus_implied: mean(won) - mean(1 / odds) at the bet price
stats.diff_test: ROI(A) - ROI(B), match dates resampled jointly over the union of both sets' dates; one-sided p for A > B

families.F1_decision: every tested cell with at least one bet: model AGREE / DISAGREE / NONE / ALL and market FOLLOW, all windows, signals, tracks, market-sides, leagues. Holm over the whole family.
families.F2_contrasts: per model cell (window x signal x track x market-side x league): AGREE - NONE, AGREE - DISAGREE, AGREE - MARKET_FOLLOW (same window, signal, league, side). Holm over F2. Reported for questions 2-3; not a staking decision.

proven.rule: PROVEN = at least 150 bets AND Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.025 AND the ROI 95% CI lower bound > 0 (the owner's strict rule). PROMISING = ROI > 0 and CLV > 0 or unmeasured (the bars study's rule). Else UNPROVEN.

timing.question_4: (a) actual lead of the chosen open / signal / bet snapshots; (b) Pinnacle's fair-Over path from the open snapshot (same line): mean |change| and share with the sign of the final movement per lead bucket; (c) per MODEL cell: tips at the BT (live lead time) Pinnacle price, how many are still a tip at the W72_6 bet price, and how many of those get PIN AGREE, per active league-week.

forward: Any PROVEN or PROMISING model-AGREE cell becomes a forward PAPER protocol from 2026-11-21 (fixed definitions above, thresholds from all history before each fixture, Pinnacle prices captured live at T-72 h and T-6 h); nothing is staked without a new owner decision.
licence: The repo is public: results.json and the report hold counts, ROI, CI, p and lead statistics only; every per-row frame (prices) stays in --work outside the repo.
pre_registration_coverage: Counts measured BEFORE registration with no outcome read (scripts/sharp_filter_study.py coverage): 27,666 universe fixtures matched to a provider event; W72_6 window readable on 20,294 fixtures; Pinnacle O/U move kind SAME 13,493 / LINE 5,443 / none 1,358; Pinnacle quotes the exact 2.5 pair in the W72_6 bet snapshot on only 5,368 fixtures (its single featured line is often 2.25/2.75), so the model arm counts about 1,190 tips over all MODEL cells and every class; no model cell can reach 150 bets in one class. Other books quoting 2.5 at both snapshots: median 5 per fixture; consensus_min_books set to 3 (was drafted at 5, which left 53% of fixtures without a consensus). 1X2: Pinnacle triples at both snapshots on 20,155 fixtures.
